input.free_text_description: This system is a content management platform that serves Content Creator, User roles. The platform provides capabilities for query history, like, post. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a Content Creator, I want to search and filter records, so that I can quickly find relevant information.
As a Content Creator, I want to use like capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Content Creator, I want to use post capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Content Creator, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
